Name: Jonathan, Son of Abiathar
Summary: Jonathan, son of Abiathar, served as a secret messenger for David during Absalom's revolt, carrying word from Jerusalem with Ahimaaz and hiding from Absalom's men.
KeyStory: Jonathan risked his life as a boy-messenger between Jerusalem and David's camp.
RelatedPeople: Abiathar, Son of Ahimelech; Ahimaaz, Son of Zadok; King David; Abiathar, Priest; Adonijah, Son of Haggith; King Solomon
LifeLesson: Young messengers in a civil war carry the kingdom on their feet.
